g.text: Looking at the back of the robot — same scale as the top view
Used for power, code uploads, and serial communication.
These light only when the robot power switch is ON.
Lights whenever a live USB cable is connected.
Power switch — slide RIGHT for ON
(as you face the back of the robot)
you are looking at the back.
